openai.feedback:
- Category: edge-case  
  Severity: medium  
  File: server/src/core/model-tier-config-reader.ts:53-55  
  Finding: Main-worktree resolution assumes the common Git directory is `<main-worktree>/.git` and returns `dirname(commonDir)`. This is false for valid Git layouts using a separate git directory or submodules, where the common directory can be elsewhere (for example, `.git/modules/<submodule>`). In those projects the reader looks for `shipwright_model_config.json` in the parent of the Git metadata directory rather than the project’s main worktree, causing the card to silently show inherited defaults instead of the framework configuration.  
  Suggestion: Resolve the main worktree path using `git worktree list --porcelain` (selecting the primary worktree) rather than deriving it from `--git-common-dir`; retain `projectPath` only as the non-Git fallback.

- Category: test  
  Severity: medium  
  File: client/e2e/flows/model-tier-defaults.spec.ts:61-74, 109-115  
  Finding: The test proves command generation only by manually POSTing `{ "review-model": "opus" }` to the launch API, while the browser flow merely checks that the UI command preview contains the flag. It never submits the browser-selected override and verifies the command generated for that selection. A regression that displays the advanced selection and preview correctly but omits that parameter from the modal’s launch payload would pass. It also does not assert that execution/standalone-Plan override fields are absent, so the “only supported overrides are offered” portion of AC4 is not protected.  
  Suggestion: Submit the modal after selecting `review-model=opus` and intercept or inspect the resulting launch command/payload. Add negative assertions that no execution override appears in Iterate and no unsupported model override is offered by standalone Plan.

Overall assessment: the ordinary worktree implementation meets the primary behavior, but main-worktree discovery is incorrect for supported nonstandard Git layouts and the E2E coverage does not verify the actual UI-to-launch path. Ship with fixes.  
SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise

deepseek.feedback:
- Category: spec  
- Severity: medium  
- File: server/src/core/model-tier-config-reader.ts:49–54 (`resolveModelConfigRoot`)  
- Finding: The `--path-format=absolute` flag used in `git rev-parse` is only available in Git ≥ 2.31. On systems with an older Git, the command will fail, and the fallback to `projectPath` will cause linked worktrees to read their own divergent `shipwright_model_config.json` instead of the main worktree copy, violating acceptance criterion 3 (linked worktrees must read the main-worktree config).  
- Suggestion: Provide an alternative resolution that works without `--path-format=absolute` (e.g., parse `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` and resolve relative paths with `path.resolve`, or use `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` inside the main worktree), or document the minimum Git version and refuse to serve config from linked worktrees when the resolution is uncertain.

---

The implementation satisfies all other acceptance criteria and is well-tested, but the linked-worktree resolution can silently break under older Git, compromising the explicit guarantee in the spec. That should be addressed before general release.

SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise
